policy: Reminders {{windows}} days before expiry. A rotated token keeps working for {{grace}}.

rotate.platformTooltip: Platform tokens rotate themselves and cannot be rotated here.
rotate.title: Rotate {{name}}?
rotate.body: A new token is created with the same name, abilities and scope, and a fresh lifetime.
rotate.grace: The old token keeps working for {{grace}} so you can switch callers, then it is revoked.
rotate.noGrace: The old token is revoked at once.
rotate.doneBody: Update everything that uses the old token with this secret.
rotate.warning: Copy this token now. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved later.
rotate.oldRevoked: The old token was revoked at once.

errors.forbidden: Platform tokens rotate themselves and cannot be rotated here.
errors.conflict: This token is already revoked, so there is nothing to rotate. The list was refreshed.
errors.notFound: This token no longer exists or belongs to someone else.
errors.network: Could not reach the server. Nothing was rotated, try again.
